mapper.select: SELECT p.prescription_id, p.register_id, p.drug_id, p.drug_num, p.subtotal, dr.drug_name, dr.price, dr.unit FROM prescription p JOIN drug dr ON p.drug_id = dr.drug_id WHERE p.register_id = #{registerId} ORDER BY p.prescription_id
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(subtotal), 0) FROM prescription WHERE register_id = #{registerId}
